objective: Speak with Deliana at The High Seat in Ironforge.

description: I suppose that this is goodbye then, my friend. But, I'll always be here if you want to come back and talk with me from time to time. Probably while you're loitering around waiting for your buddies to join you for a raid on Blackrock Spire.
Go, before I start to cry. Go back to Deliana in Ironforge and tell her what's happened.
completion: I am very happy to see you return to me safely, <name>. You look well, if not a bit worse for the wear.
Come, tell me of all that has transpired.
